_comment: Canonical JLCPCB order settings for MIDI Brain. tscircuit has no prop for surface finish or assembly side, so these live here and are copied into fab/ by `make release`. Upload the artifacts listed in docs/JLC-ASSEMBLY.md and set these options on the order page. Prototype outputs, not a fabrication release: `make release` runs the physical acceptance gate first and exports nothing while an item in hardware-acceptance.json is unresolved. expected_counts are verified against the generated BOM/CPL on every release; update them from the generated output, never by guessing.

assembly.sides_reason: All 31 SMT placements are on the top (panel side). The rear face carries only the J5 THT body and THT tails.
assembly.through_hole: hand solder except U6: qualified process required
assembly.through_hole_note: J1-J4 and SW1-SW6 are hand-solderable. U6 (Bourns PEC11R encoder) is not recommended for hand soldering: its row asks for a qualified THT process (selective/wave or validated manual) until acceptance item encoder_solder_process records the process. U6 stays out of the SMT CPL.

assembly.sides_reason: All 20 SMT placements are on the bottom (C13/C14 added by the electrical work: 18 -> 20); THT sockets/headers are hand-soldered after SMT.
assembly.through_hole_note: J_PI/J_FRONT use the selected XFCN imported headers with reference C-numbers; Pico sockets need exact bench sourcing. All four headers/sockets are THT and stay out of the SMT CPL.
assembly.counts_note: C13/C14 are new rear SMT capacitors from the electrical work: bom 22 -> 24 placements, CPL 18 -> 20, all bottom. If the electrical implementation adds or removes a placement, this release fails with the exact delta until the numbers here are updated from the generated files.

board.acceptance_note: Confirm JLCPCB accepts a no-solder-mask both-sides FR-4 order before paying; still an open item.
